manager.label: CurseForge
notes: Reads the jars in each CurseForge instance's mods folder. One entry per instance, so a modpack imports as the set of mods it actually installed.
If you changed CurseForge's install folder, this finds nothing — drop a descriptor naming your folder in the app's plugins/manager folder.
CurseForge's API needs a key issued per application and does not answer 'what has this user installed', so this reads the instance folders instead. They are the authority anyway.
